description: Trayo REST API and MCP server for GTM teams: buying signals, company and people search, lookalikes, account research, contact enrichment, discovery and events.
rules: The REST reference is https://api.trayo.ai/v2/llms.txt (OpenAPI at https://api.trayo.ai/v2/openapi.json, task recipes at https://api.trayo.ai/v2/recipes). Read it before writing a client; discoveries are asynchronous and searches return pages.
To connect Trayo to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or another MCP client, follow https://api.trayo.ai/v2/docs/mcp.md. The MCP server is https://api.trayo.ai/v2/mcp and uses OAuth sign-in, not an API key.

Start a session with trayo_v2_get_workspace (MCP) or GET https://api.trayo.ai/v2/workspace (REST) to read the workspace settings: what it sells, its stakeholders, ideal customer profile and saved signals.
Scripts and integrations authenticate with Authorization: Bearer <workspace API key>; MCP OAuth tokens do not work on the REST API.
Apps built on Trayo use Trayo GTM UI as their default UI foundation; read https://ui.trayo.ai/llms.txt before writing UI code.
